did: The worker made a story's build wait while a sibling sharing a code file builds.
The worker made a waiting story plan again once that sibling merges.
decided: A story holds the turn once a worker ran or its pull request opened.
Asking for work on a waiting story builds nothing and names the other story.

handback.summary: Two stories can still build a shared file at once while the first story's worker is running.

raises.label: 668.1 test too weak
raises.text: A story counts as building only once its worker finishes. While its worker runs, a sibling sharing its file starts building too. Add that case to the 668.1 test.
raises.evidence: `dokima/turns.py` `building()` sees only a record or open pull request; `agent.yml` writes both after the agent.
